name: codex-chat-local-tools
description: Multi-machine local coding tools with startup Codex AGENTS injection and progressive skill sync.

interface.shortDescription: Windows and Mac tools with Codex context sync.
interface.longDescription: A tool-only MCP plugin that gives Codex ChatGPT mode deterministic access to explicitly configured Windows and Mac workspaces, injects local Codex-visible AGENTS guidance during MCP initialization, and progressively loads skills without browser automation or response scraping.
defaultPrompt: Help me inspect and modify code in one of my configured local workspaces.
